decisions.reason: The source changes the purpose of the hero image but does not alter the established hero headline or explanatory copy.
Specifying what the hero image should demonstrate does not change the landing page's content mix, specification source, or screenshot-selection rule.
The hero image's product-demonstration purpose does not modify the approved visual style, design reference, or brand-colour source.
The source addresses only the hero image and does not change the independently specified replacement image at the bottom of the page.
